name: Jigjiga University Modular Data Center Infrastructure Project
notes: Tender aggregators report Jigjiga University notice JJU/NCB/013/2015E.C for construction, installation, migration, training and commissioning of a modular data center infrastructure project on a turnkey basis in Somali Region; bid deadline was 2023-05-26 and no completion/capacity evidence was found.

name: Kabridahar University Standardised Data Centre
notes: Kabridahar University's ICT Directorate states it administers the university's main IT infrastructure including the data center, networks and ICT equipment, and that the university owns a standardized data centre with fiber backbone and campus LAN in Somali Regional State.

name: Jigjiga University Data Center
notes: Jigjiga University's ICT/application development page refers to university rules for hosting software in the university Data Center, indicating an operational institutional data center; no capacity details found.

name: Mizan Tepi University Data Center Environment
developer: Mizan Tepi University; IE Network Solutions
notes: IE Network Solutions lists delivery of supply, installation, configuration and commissioning of a Data Center Environment for Mizan Tepi University, project size over 45M ETB; 2024 tender notices for data center system support and maintenance indicate the center remained in service.

name: Bonga University Data Center Power Facility
notes: A 2026 eGP-sourced tender notice by Bonga University is for corrective and preventive maintenance of a data center power facility, supporting an operational institutional data center or data center power plant; no capacity data found.

name: Mekelle University Tier-III Data Center
notes: Mekelle University's ICT Directorate page describes all six campuses interconnected via high-speed fiber networks and identifies a Tier-III Data Center operated by the directorate; no power capacity disclosed.

name: Mekelle University Software-Defined Data Center Tender
notes: EthiopiaTenders lists Mekelle University tender ICB 001/2013 E.C./LOT 1 for a Software-Defined Data Center with bid deadline 2021-07-29; source does not confirm award/completion or capacity.

name: Adigrat University Main Data Center IDS2000-M
notes: Adigrat University's ICT page says its ICT modernization project is centered on the Main Data Center IDS2000-M, with integrated IT, power and cooling systems, smart monitoring, hybrid grid/diesel/solar backup, and NOC; no MW capacity disclosed.
